title: SafeKey: Amplifying Aha-Moment Insights for Safety Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety reasoning and alignment in Large Reasoning Models. It evaluates model performance across several safety benchmarks to ensure responses adhere to ethical safety policies (such as refusing to assist in criminal or harmful activities). The methodology and evaluation criteria, specifically the safety judge scoring rubric in Table 9, are centered on ethical alignment and normative reasoning regarding model behavior.
